title: tau config validate report
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau config validate [--json]` prints on stdout (the default under --mode json). The command exits 0 when "ok" is true and 1 when it is false, so CI/pre-commit can branch on the exit code or the flag. Validation findings are informational — the set of issue messages may grow; never match on their contents.

path.description: The config file that was validated (positional argument or the default ~/.config/tau/config.json).

ok.description: true when the file parsed and every key passed the schema checks.

errors.description: Every problem found, in file order. Empty when ok is true.

key.description: The offending config key; null for file-level problems (unreadable file, invalid JSON, non-object top level).

message.description: Human-readable problem description — informational, may be reworded.

errors.message: top level must be a JSON object, got an array
